arguments.content: Recovery/idempotency review pattern: when completed recovery records are retained for audit, selecting the first record by resource scope (such as workspace) makes a historical operation suppress later operations indefinitely. Recovery identity must follow the caller's operation ID; resource identity alone is not an idempotency key. Check successive fresh IDs for the same resource and verify both active state and a distinct audit record. Observed P1 in service.py save.
